name: lorisse
description: A memory that is yours, in plain files on your machine. You talk; Lorisse files what matters, finds it again, keeps your documents with it, sorts it into drawers by itself, and every change can be taken back.

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: The folder that holds your memory, used when the session is opened somewhere else. A session opened on a memory folder uses that folder.
